sections.title: The Fm Stamp
sections.blurb: Charcoal and white squares, one centred line, the yellow “#Fake Muchatlu” tag up top and the chunky Fm mark in the corner. Where it all started.

sections.title: Dashed Frames
sections.blurb: The Fm logo moves to the top, cards get a dotted border and a tiny mascot signs off at the bottom. A short, tidy experiment.

sections.title: Tweet Cards
sections.blurb: Everything becomes a tweet: avatar, handle, a line of Telugu-English and lots of white space. Lockdown-era thoughts, Season 01s and the occasional meme.

sections.title: Paper Notes
sections.blurb: “Stories by a mediocre Indian”: typewriter serif on grey paper and brown kraft. Quieter, slower, more writerly.

sections.title: Clean Notes & Chats
sections.blurb: Bare white notes with a small Fm stamp, chat-bubble screenshots and the weekly “mental health challenge” lists.

sections.title: Dark Serif
sections.blurb: Black cards, big bookish serif, mustard words that carry the punch. A brief, moody run.

sections.title: Meme Tweets
sections.blurb: Back to tweets, now with the red FM avatar and Telugu cinema stills doing half the talking.

sections.title: Notes App
sections.blurb: Long plain-text notes, numbered lists and iMessage bubbles. The words, unstyled.

sections.title: After Dark
sections.blurb: Pitch-black cards with heavy white type and the odd neon word, plus serif lines on white.

sections.title: Photo Poems
sections.blurb: Grainy landscapes, beaches and open skies with a line of serif text laid over them.

sections.title: Poster Lab
sections.blurb: Full design mode: crimson, cream and forest green, condensed poster type, halftone cut-outs, a ghost in sunglasses.

sections.title: The Red Room
sections.blurb: Every card on deep crimson with mustard italic serif and hand-drawn characters. The current look.
